title: 💰 Union Budget 2026–27 — Fiscal Targets, Capex Push & Direct Tax Overhaul
executiveSummary: Union Budget allocated ₹2,000 crore incentive for low-value P2M UPI and RuPay debit card transactions with zero MDR. Zero MDR made effective Jan 2020.
masterKeyFacts: Union Budget allocated ₹2,000 crore incentive for low-value P2M UPI and RuPay debit card transactions with zero MDR. Zero MDR made effective Jan 2020.
Centre set disinvestment and asset monetization target of Rs 80,000 crore for FY27 (135% higher than RE FY26 of Rs 33,837 Cr), banking on IDBI Bank and LIC.
DMEO NITI Aayog prepares annual OOMF for all central schemes with outlay ≥₹500 Crore laid alongside Union Budget.
Highest-ever sports budget allocation: ₹4,479.88 Cr for Sports Ministry, ₹924.35 Cr for Khelo India scheme, ₹500 Cr for sports goods manufacturing.
₹3,000 Cr allocated to NICDIT under NICDP (11 corridors under PM GatiShakti, NICDC est. 2008).
YIL board empowered for capex up to ₹500 crore without government clearance.
